create_TensorMetadata: create a TensorMetadata NamedTuple containing shape, dtype, requires_grad, stride, memory_format, is_quantized, and qparams for a PyTorch tensor
build_shape_propagation: build a ShapeProp instance to propagate tensor shapes and dtypes through a torch.fx.GraphModule node-by-node
run_shape_propagation: run shape propagation on a GraphModule with sample inputs to record tensor_meta and type metadata on each node
run_node_shape_prop: run a single node in a ShapeProp interpreter and extract tensor metadata into the node's meta dictionary
extract_tensor_metadata: extract TensorMetadata from a PyTorch tensor including shape, dtype, stride, memory_format, and quantization parameters
